title: Steer-to-Detect: Probing Hidden Representations for Detection of LLM-Generated Texts
abstract: arXiv:2605.12890v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has made machine-generated text increasingly difficult to distinguish from human-written text. While recent studies explore leveraging internal representations of language models to uncover deeper detection signals, these raw features often exhibit substantial overlap between classes, limiting their discriminative power. To address this challenge, we propose Steer-to-Detect (\texttt{S2D}), a two-stage framework for detecting LLM-generated text. In the first stage, \texttt{S2D} learns a steering vector that is injected into the hidden states of a frozen observer LLM, producing representations with improved class separability. In the second stage, detection is performed via a hypothesis testing procedure based on the steered representations. translated_title: Steer-to-Detect：通过探测隐藏表示来检测大语言模型生成的文本
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展使得机器生成的文本越来越难以与人类撰写的文本区分开来。尽管近期研究探索利用语言模型的内部表示来挖掘更深层的检测信号，但这些原始特征在类别之间往往存在大量重叠，限制了其判别能力。为解决这一挑战，我们提出了 Steer-to-Detect（S2D），一种用于检测 LLM 生成文本的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，S2D 学习一个导向向量并将其注入冻结的观察者 LLM 的隐藏状态中，从而产生类别可分性更好的表示。在第二阶段，基于导向后的表示，通过假设检验程序完成检测。我们为第一类错误和第二类错误建立了有限样本、高概率的理论保证，为所提方法提供了理论刻画。
tldr: 提出两阶段检测框架 Steer-to-Detect（S2D），通过学习导向向量改善冻结观察者 LLM 隐藏表示的类别可分性，并基于假设检验实现 LLM 生成文本检测，同时为两类错误提供有限样本高概率理论保证。
en_tdlr: Proposes Steer-to-Detect (S2D), a two-stage framework that learns a steering vector injected into a frozen observer LLM to improve class separability of hidden representations, and detects LLM-generated text via hypothesis testing with finite-sample high-probability guarantees on Type I and Type II errors.
